vision.quote: IRCTC delivered record revenue and profitability in FY26 with revenue from operations up 11.55% YoY to ₹5,215 Cr and PAT up 6% to ₹1,393 Cr. The company is targeting 30% EBITDA margin through Rail Neer expansion, Payment Aggregator licence, and premium Vande Bharat catering — diversifying the revenue mix while protecting the monopoly moat.

valuation.methodology: AlphaSpread live 15 Oct 2026 — DCF ₹629.91 (via FCFE template, 15yr, Rev growth 9.6% vs 5Y hist 46.4%, Net margin 27.0% vs hist 28.9%, Discount 10.4%, Exit 25.9x P/E) + Multiples-Based ₹181.83 → Intrinsic = DCF (AlphaSpread selects best-fit method). Local cross-check: trailing 27.6× P/E, 8.86× P/B, EV/EBITDA ~18.5×, OPM 31% TTM, ROCE 46%.

trends: Monopoly ticketing cash cow — 89% share, 83% margin, 70.6M users, 1.56M tickets/day
Catering scale inflection — Vande Bharat 260 trains + e-catering + static units drive 13% growth
Rail Neer capacity doubling — 4 new plants + 2 expansions target ₹600+ Cr at 30% EBITDA
Payment Aggregator licence imminent — own gateway saves MDR, opens merchant acquiring revenue
Tourism +19.5% YoY — Bharat Darshan, pilgrimage, State Teertha diversifying beyond railway
big_messages: FY26 record revenue ₹5,215 Cr (+11.6%) and PAT ₹1,393 Cr (+6%); dividend ₹9/sh (52% payout, highest ever)
Q1 FY27 revenue ₹1,370 Cr (+18% YoY) but PAT flat at ₹330 Cr — margin compression from catering mix shift
Rail Neer capacity expansion on track — Mysore, Prayagraj land secured; 2 plants doubling capacity
Payment Aggregator licence application filed — target August 2026 approval; own payment stack
red_flags: Q1 FY27 margin compression — OPM 28% vs 34% YoY; catering mix shift dilutes blended margin
Tourism volatility — 17% of revenue but swing factor; PAT flat despite 18% revenue growth in Q1
Valuation premium — 27.6× P/E, 8.86× P/B vs leisure peers 15-20×; AlphaSpread multiples model ₹182 (62% overvalued)
Promoter (GoI) 62.4% — divestment overhang; FII holding fell 7.4% → 3.5% in 12 months
Single-client concentration — Indian Railways >95% of revenue; policy/regulatory risk

anchor.guidance: Mgmt: 30% EBITDA target; Rail Neer ₹600+ Cr; Payment Aggregator Aug-26; 260 Vande Bharat catering

logic: Base 12% CAGR tracks 5Y history (14% 3Y) slowing as monopoly saturates; Rail Neer + Payment Aggregator + Vande Bharat provide uplift
Bear = margin compression persists (catering/tourism mix) + P/E derates to 18× (sector avg) + no Payment Aggregator uplift
Bull = Payment Aggregator + Rail Neer 30% EBITDA + tourism scale + Vande Bharat premium catering + P/E holds 28×
Key insight: EPS spread ₹22 → ₹38.5 (~1.75×) smaller than price spread — multiple does heavy lifting; ROCE 46% supports premium
Monitor quarterly: blended OPM vs 30% target, Rail Neer revenue/margin, Payment Aggregator launch, tourism PAT contribution, FII flow

takeaway: IRCTC doesn't sell train tickets — it sells the only gateway to India's railway network, and the filings say the next chapter is monetising that monopoly through payments, premium catering, and packaged water at scale — engineered in New Delhi, mandated by Parliament, compounding at 46% ROCE.
